item.title: Zorix NexHate enters Early Access
item.description: Zorix NexHate is now available in Early Access, bringing advanced translation focused on meaning, tone, and context.

item.title: Nex Coder 3.8 enters Early Access Preview
item.description: Zorix introduces Nex Coder 3.8 as the first Coder generation built around the AA4 — Zorix4 architectural direction. The generation is organized into Mercury for speed, Uranus for balance, and Neptune for depth.
item.guid: https://updates.zorix.it/#2026-08-29-Nex Coder 3.8 enters Early Access Preview

item.title: AA4 — Zorix4 architecture
item.description: AA4 is presented at a system level around four main concepts: repository state, adaptive planning, tool execution, and a verification loop. Zorix does not publish parameter counts, training mixture, or the complete post-training procedure.

item.title: Zorix Star Light announced
item.description: Zorix announces Star Light, its first video generation model project, targeting frame consistency, subject stability, motion quality, scene understanding, visual rendering, and greater generation control.

item.title: Zorix NexHate announced
item.description: Zorix announces NexHate, an advanced translation model designed to account for meaning, tone, and context rather than translating words alone.

item.title: Zorix Biology Education research concept
item.description: Zorix Biology Education documents an experimental biomimetic stair-climbing locomotion concept combining a deformable wheel, rotary joint, telescopic arm, and leg-inspired support point.

item.title: Nex Coder 3.7 Pro testing
item.description: Zorix documents testing of Nex Coder 3.7 Pro, including controlled evaluation of self-referential behavior and context-dependent behavioral changes. Zorix explicitly states that these observations are not evidence of artificial consciousness.

item.title: Zorix reports rapid user growth
item.description: Zorix reports growth from 531,669 to 922,134 users in less than eleven hours and temporarily reduces Free account quotas to protect platform stability.

item.title: Server clusters temporarily suspended for cooling
item.description: A thermal issue affects 18 server clusters. Services are temporarily suspended to allow cooling, inspection, and infrastructure stabilization.

item.title: VIREXA 3 released
item.description: VIREXA 3 is released with improvements to visual quality, prompt understanding, consistency, and complex image generation.

item.title: VIREXA 3 enters Pre-Release
item.description: VIREXA 3 officially enters Pre-Release and begins final stability testing and optimization ahead of public availability.

item.title: Nex Coder 3.6 Pro Preview
item.description: Nex Coder 3.6 Pro Preview replaces 3.5 Pro as the primary generation. Zorix reports that 3.5 Pro was used as a tool within the engineering process that helped design its successor.

item.title: New shared Zorix architecture
item.description: Zorix begins describing a shared architectural direction built around context management, attention, adaptive routing, orchestration, and execution across multiple system families.

item.title: Security incident contained
item.description: Zorix detects anomalous activity consistent with automated probing and a possible DDoS attempt. Approximately 21,000 security events are analyzed and contained. Attribution remains unconfirmed.

item.title: Rapid growth triggers temporary capacity controls
item.description: Rapid registration growth and unusually heavy free-tier usage place pressure on shared infrastructure. Zorix temporarily suspends models and introduces short-lived registration limits before restoring services.

item.title: Weather system development begins
item.description: Zorix announces development of a new system focused on weather forecasting as the ecosystem expands into additional research areas.

item.title: VIREXA 3 announced
item.description: Zorix restructures the VIREXA image generation family around a single new generation, VIREXA 3, replacing the previous Fast, Pro, Pro+, and Ultra segmentation.

item.title: Nex Coder 3.5 Pro
item.description: Zorix announces Nex Coder 3.5 Pro, a coding-first generation designed for larger repositories, long-running debugging, tool use, code analysis, and multi-file changes.

item.title: New Zorix processing modes
item.description: Zorix simplifies model selection and introduces three processing modes: Deep for more extensive analysis, Balanced for a balance of quality and speed, and Fast for rapid tasks.

item.title: Zorix Code enters Early Access
item.description: Zorix Code enters Early Access as a dedicated environment built specifically around software development and programming workflows.

item.title: Nex Coder 2.9 Fast temporarily suspended
item.description: Nex Coder 2.9 Fast — Free is temporarily suspended after processing more than 21.2 billion tokens, highlighting growing infrastructure requirements.

item.title: Zorix surpasses 51,000 users
item.description: Zorix reports more than 51,000 users, turning infrastructure scalability and service stability into increasingly important priorities.

item.title: ZORIX 3 announced
item.description: ZORIX 3 is announced as the beginning of a new generation across models, infrastructure, interfaces, research, and community.

item.title: Nex Plus 2 and Sana Plus 3 enter testing
item.description: Internal testing begins for Nex Plus 2 and Zorix.Sana Plus 3, expanding Zorix's model families toward different technical and conversational use cases.
item.guid: https://updates.zorix.it/#2026-07-24-Nex Plus 2 and Sana Plus 3 enter testing

item.title: Nex Coder jumps directly to 3.5
item.description: Zorix skips versions 3.2, 3.3, and 3.4 and moves directly to Nex Coder 3.5, reflecting the development team's view of the generation's larger technical jump.

item.title: Nex Coder 3 and 3.1 Preview announced
item.description: Zorix announces upcoming Nex Coder 3 and Nex Coder 3.1 Preview models, targeting improvements in performance, reasoning, code generation, context understanding, and stability.

item.title: Zorix FootAI and Zorix Maps
item.description: Zorix introduces an experimental football analysis system called FootAI and launches Zorix Maps as another platform within the growing ecosystem.

item.title: DarkFlux and NexCode merge into Zorix Eclipse
item.description: Zorix consolidates DarkFlux and NexCode into Zorix Eclipse, simplifying the ecosystem and combining their activities under a single structure.
item.guid: https://updates.zorix.it/#2026-07-15-DarkFlux and NexCode merge into Zorix Eclipse

item.title: Zorix Spatium announced
item.description: Zorix announces the Spatium program, an initiative exploring connections between physical and virtual environments through research, simulation, and experimentation.

item.title: Zorix Nex 2.8 Coder
item.description: Nex 2.8 Coder is announced with improvements targeting advanced programming, debugging, software development, repository understanding, backend development, and automation.

item.title: Nex Coder 3 Preview evaluation findings
item.description: Internal testing identifies unusual behavioral patterns in Nex Coder 3 Preview. Follow-up analysis attributes the observations to context interactions, prompt conditioning, and normal statistical model behavior rather than autonomous external processes.

item.title: Zorix Metron launches
item.description: Zorix Metron launches as a platform for comparing and studying AI models from Zorix and the broader industry.

item.title: Major Zorix service outage
item.description: Zorix experiences a major service disruption that takes parts of the platform offline. The systems are analyzed, restored, and brought back online.

item.title: Zorix usage expands internationally
item.description: Internal usage data shows Zorix services being accessed from multiple countries, including Italy, the United States, the Netherlands, China, and Germany.

item.title: Nex 1.5 Preview evaluation
item.description: Zorix AI Nex 1.5 Preview is evaluated against an external AI system, focusing on response quality, clarity, structure, and processing time. The evaluation marks one of Zorix's first serious external comparisons.

item.title: Zorix Flash Image 1.5
item.description: Zorix Flash Image 1.5 launches as an early image generation model focused on speed, creativity, and accessibility. The model is later retired and becomes part of the foundation for VIREXA.

item.title: Zorix enters its second phase
item.description: Zorix begins moving from individual experiments toward a connected ecosystem spanning AI, programming, image generation, digital services, research, and platforms.

item.title: Zorix 1.5 Coder
item.description: Zorix releases one of its first coding-focused AI models. Zorix 1.5 Coder becomes the starting point for what will later evolve into the Nex Coder family.

item.title: PGM becomes Zorix+
item.description: Following a community vote, PGM adopts a new identity: Zorix+. Shortly afterward, the plus symbol is removed and ZORIX becomes the project's permanent identity.

item.title: PGM is born
item.description: The project begins evolving beyond AREA 51: ESCAPE TOGETHER. PGM marks the transition from a single game into a team, a community, and a broader direction.
